prompt: A small steel relay hut half-buried in a glacier: a squat insulated prefab hut with an arched corrugated roof, ribbed steel wall panels, a heavy steel door at the front, one small square window, a stovepipe chimney, and on its roof a large long-range parabolic dish antenna on a heavy turning mount, wider than the hut, tilted up toward the sky. A short lattice antenna mast stands beside the dish. The hut sits on a thick angular block of glacier ice with clean faceted edges, snow drifted up against one wall. Industrial polar outpost hardware. Isolated 3D model render on a plain uniform medium-grey studio background, the whole object fully in frame with generous margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, soft even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no text, no lettering, no logos, no people. Crisp hard-surface modelling with bold, clearly separated parts and a strong readable silhouette: chunky forms and clean edges, no clutter, no hanging moss, no dangling wires.
